Demo JavaScript

JavaScript
var wizardState = { 'wizard-basic': 1, 'wizard-progress': 1, 'wizard-nonlinear': 1 };
var wizardTotal = { 'wizard-basic': 3, 'wizard-progress': 3, 'wizard-nonlinear': 3 };

function wizardNav(id, dir) {
  var current = wizardState[id];
  var next = current + dir;
  if (next < 1 || next > wizardTotal[id]) {
    if (next > wizardTotal[id]) { alert('Form submitted!'); }
    return;
  }
  goToStep(id, next);
}

function goToStep(id, step) {
  var total = wizardTotal[id];
  wizardState[id] = step;
  for (var i = 1; i <= total; i++) {
    var panel = document.getElementById(id + '-p' + i);
    if (panel) panel.style.display = i === step ? '' : 'none';
  }
  var prevBtn = document.getElementById(id + '-prev');
  var nextBtn = document.getElementById(id + '-next');
  if (prevBtn) prevBtn.style.visibility = step === 1 ? 'hidden' : 'visible';
  if (nextBtn) nextBtn.textContent = step === total ? 'Submit' : 'Next';

  // Update progress bar
  if (id === 'wizard-progress') {
    var pct = Math.round((step / total) * 100);
    document.getElementById('wizard-progress-bar').style.width = pct + '%';
    document.getElementById('wizard-progress-current').textContent = step;
    document.getElementById('wizard-progress-pct').textContent = pct + '%';
  }
}
